title: Chicken Fajitas
description: Sizzling chicken and bell peppers, served with warm flour tortillas. A classic Mexican dish that's easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet.
Add sliced bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add cooked chicken back to the skillet and stir to combine with pepper mixture.
Warm flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble fajitas by placing cooked chicken and pepper mixture onto a tortilla and serving with salsa, savory, and verde (if using).
